reuse.why: Introduces one getMonthWideBudgetCategories selection that all six month-wide actions (including the new setLastMonthSpending) use, and reuses the existing extractTagsFromText, getSheetValue and setBudget helpers.

duplication.why: Replaces five per-action category queries with one shared selection; only the per-action income/tracking check stays repeated as before.

placement.why: Selection lives in budget/actions.ts next to the actions it serves, and the new handler is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings with mutator(undoable(...)).

scope.why: Changes cover the four requested steps (exclusions, new action, #fixed groups, include-hidden flag) plus tests and release notes, nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: A shared MonthWideArgs type and single selection function make the rules easy to change in one place; the helper's leading comment describes the excluded categories while it returns the included ones, and the income rule could also have moved into it.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideBudgetCategories in budget/actions.ts gains the requested includeHiddenCategories option with a single hiddenFilter branch; all month-wide actions call it (copyPreviousMonth via an eligible-id set)
